body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/3690-claude-room-freed` (head `56b4f317`, on upstream `6afbe3f3`) — `claudeRoom` hands its freed channel to the waiter that needs it, so a run ending outside its bubble is no crash.

**Root cause.** `internal/gateway/claude_room.go`'s `release` did `close(c.freed); c.freed = make(chan struct{})` unconditionally, while `nudge` guards the same pair with `if c.waiting > 0`. Closing a channel that belongs to another synctest bubble — or replacing it under a waiter that is already on the old one — is what the report's bubble hit.

**Change.** the channel is now made by the first waiter and dropped with the last: a `wake` helper (used by both `nudge` and `release`) closes and clears it only while `waiting > 0`, and `take` makes it if nil under the same lock it waits with, so no waiter is left on a closed-and-replaced channel.

**Verified.** Red: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/ -run TestClaudeRoom` → `fatal error: close of synctest channel from outside bubble` at `claudeRoomT.release` (the test binary dies; `claude_room.go:294`)
Green: `same command → `ok`; the room reports 0 runs and 0 waiting afterwards, and an ask waiting on a full room is woken by a release and takes it (`TestClaudeRoomLetsAnIdleRunGoAndItResumes`, `TestClaudeRoomFullIs503` also green)` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway`

This is the same shape as #3632's `filememo` fix, arrived at from the waiter side; nothing else in the file changed.

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 26's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6afbe3f3` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3690-claude-room-freed — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
